# bioexcel/biobb_flexdyn/concoord_dist

## Summary

Wrapper of the Dist tool from the Concoord package.

Structure interpretation and bond definitions from a PDB/GRO file.

Nextflow adapter of the [ConcoordDist](https://biobb-flexdyn.readthedocs.io/en/latest/flexdyn.html#module-flexdyn.concoord_dist) building block of [biobb_flexdyn](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_flexdyn) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_FLEXDYN_CONCOORD_DIST } from 'bioexcel/biobb_flexdyn/concoord_dist'

workflow {
    BIOBB_FLEXDYN_CONCOORD_DIST(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_structure_path` | yes | pdb, gro | Input structure file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Output pdb file |
| `output_gro_path` | yes | gro | Output gro file |
| `output_dat_path` | yes | dat, txt | Output dat with structure interpretation and bond definitions |
| `versions_biobb_flexdyn` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_flexdyn', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of ConcoordDist properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_pdb_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_flexdyn container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_FLEXDYN_CONCOORD_DIST' {
        ext.properties = [vdw: 1]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `binary_path` | string | "dist" | Concoord dist binary path to be used. |
| `vdw` | integer | 1 | Select a set of Van der Waals parameters. Values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. |
| `concoord_lib_path` | string | null | Path to Concoord library files. If not specified will look for CONCOORDLIB conda environment variable. |
| `bond_angle` | integer | 1 | Select a set of bond/angle parameters. Values: 1, 2. |
| `retain_hydrogens` | boolean | false | Retain hydrogen atoms |
| `nb_interactions` | boolean | false | Try to find alternatives for non-bonded interactions (by default the native contacts will be preserved) |
| `cutoff` | number | 4.0 | cut-off radius (Angstroms) for non-bonded interacting pairs (the cut-off distances are additional to the sum of VDW radii) |
| `min_distances` | integer | 50 | Minimum number of distances to be defined for each atom |
| `damp` | number | 1.0 | Multiply each distance margin by this value |
| `fixed_atoms` | boolean | false | Interpret zero occupancy as atoms to keep fixed |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
